entries.title: Hosea 7:1
segments: ¶"When I would have healed Israel, Then the iniquity of Ephraim was uncovered, And the wickedness of Samaria. For they have committed fraud; A thief comes in; A band of robbers takes spoil outside.

entries.title: Hosea 7:2
segments: They do not consider in their hearts [That] I remember all their wickedness; Now their own deeds have surrounded them; They are before My face.

entries.title: Hosea 7:3
segments: They make a king glad with their wickedness, And princes with their lies.

entries.title: Hosea 7:4
segments: "They [are] all adulterers. Like an oven heated by a baker-He ceases stirring [the fire] after kneading the dough, Until it is leavened.

entries.title: Hosea 7:5
segments: In the day of our king Princes have made [him] sick, inflamed with wine; He stretched out his hand with scoffers.

entries.title: Hosea 7:6
segments: They prepare their heart like an oven, While they lie in wait; Their baker sleeps all night; In the morning it burns like a flaming fire.

entries.title: Hosea 7:7
segments: They are all hot, like an oven, And have devoured their judges; All their kings have fallen. None among them calls upon Me.

entries.title: Hosea 7:8
segments: ¶"Ephraim has mixed himself among the peoples; Ephraim is a cake unturned.

entries.title: Hosea 7:9
segments: Aliens have devoured his strength, But he does not know [it]; Yes, gray hairs are here and there on him, Yet he does not know [it].

entries.title: Hosea 7:10
segments: And the pride of Israel testifies to his face, But they do not return to the LORD their God, Nor seek Him for all this.

entries.title: Hosea 7:11
segments: "Ephraim also is like a silly dove, without sense-They call to Egypt, They go to Assyria.

entries.title: Hosea 7:12
segments: Wherever they go, I will spread My net on them; I will bring them down like birds of the air; I will chastise them According to what their congregation has heard.

entries.title: Hosea 7:13
segments: "Woe to them, for they have fled from Me! Destruction to them, Because they have transgressed against Me! Though I redeemed them, Yet they have spoken lies against Me.

entries.title: Hosea 7:14
segments: They did not cry out to Me with their heart When they wailed upon their beds. "They assemble together for grain and new wine, They rebel against Me;

entries.title: Hosea 7:15
segments: Though I disciplined [and] strengthened their arms, Yet they devise evil against Me;

entries.title: Hosea 7:16
segments: They return, [but] not to the Most High; They are like a treacherous bow. Their princes shall fall by the sword For the cursings of their tongue. This [shall be] their derision in the land of Egypt.
